WITH ref AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_pois_a_free WHERE fclass = 'attraction' AND name ILIKE '%Pałac Kultury%'),
ph AS (SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_free WHERE fclass = 'pharmacy'
       UNION SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_a_free WHERE fclass = 'pharmacy')
SELECT count(DISTINCT ph.osm_id)
FROM ph
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref WHERE ST_DWithin(ph.geom::geography, ref.geom::geography, 500));

Jeśli nazwa w bazie nie zawiera 'Pałac Kultury', zapytanie zwróci 0.

Pominięto apteki zapisane jako poligony.

WITH waw AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_adminareas_a_free WHERE fclass = 'admin_level6' AND name = 'Warszawa'),
wisla AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_waterways_free WHERE fclass = 'river' AND name ILIKE '%Wisła%'
          UNION ALL SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_water_a_free WHERE fclass = 'riverbank' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_waterways_free WHERE fclass = 'river' AND name ILIKE '%Wisła%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 1))
SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM gis_osm_roads_free r, waw
WHERE r.bridge = 'T'
  AND r.name <> ''
  AND r.fclass IN ('motorway','motorway_link','trunk','trunk_link','primary','primary_link','secondary','secondary_link','tertiary','tertiary_link','residential','unclassified')
  AND ST_Intersects(r.geom, waw.geom)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gis_osm_waterways_free w

sql:
WITH waw AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_adminareas_a_free WHERE fclass = 'admin_level6' AND name = 'Warszawa'),
st AS (SELECT osm_id, name, geom FROM gis_osm_transport_free WHERE fclass = 'railway_station' AND name <> ''
       UNION SELECT osm_id, name, geom FROM gis_osm_transport_a_free WHERE fclass = 'railway_station' AND name <> ''),
stw AS (SELECT st.osm_id, st.name, st.geom FROM st, waw WHERE ST_Intersects(st.geom, waw.geom)),
rest AS (SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_free WHERE fclass = 'restaurant'
         UNION SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_a_free WHERE fclass = 'restaurant')
SELECT stw.name, count(DISTINCT rest.osm_id) AS restaurants
FROM stw
LEFT JOIN rest ON ST_DWithin(stw.geom::geography, rest.geom::geography, 500)
GROUP BY stw.osm_id, stw.name
ORDER BY restaurants DESC
LIMIT 5;

Stacje kolejowe i metra to fclass 'railway_station' z obu tabel transportowych; stacji spoza Warszawy nie ograniczam, bo mogą leżeć tuż przy granicy. sql:
WITH waw AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_adminareas_a_free WHERE fclass = 'admin_level6' AND name = 'Warszawa'),
br AS (SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_free WHERE fclass = 'bicycle_rental'
       UNION SELECT osm_id, geom FROM gis_osm_pois_a_free WHERE fclass = 'bicycle_rental'),
st AS (SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_transport_free WHERE fclass = 'railway_station'
       UNION SELECT geom FROM gis_osm_transport_a_free WHERE fclass = 'railway_station'),
b AS (SELECT DISTINCT br.osm_id, br.geom FROM br, waw WHERE ST_Intersects(br.geom, waw.geom)),
flags AS (SELECT b.osm_id, bool_or(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM st WHERE ST_DWithin(b.geom::geography, st.geom::geography, 300))) AS near FROM b GROUP BY b.osm_id)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE near) AS w_promieniu_300m, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT near) AS dalej_niz_300m FROM flags;
explanation: Wypożyczalnie (punkty i poligony) ograniczono do granicy Warszawy i policzono po osm_id. Stacje kolejowe i metra to fclass 'railway_station' z obu tabel transport (metro jest w tym fclass). Przyjęto, że 'railway_halt' (mały przystanek kolejowy) nie jest stacją. Wypożyczalnie bez stacji w 300 m zaliczono jako 'dalej'.
